message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover titled "TEMPO". The background features a dark, cloudy sky. Dominating the center is a large, white fabric bag with red handles and red side panels. The bag is crumpled and has a large hole at the bottom. Bold, maroon text on the bag reads "KORUPSI BANSOS KUBU BANTENG". Below this, smaller black text begins with "Dana bantuan sosial yang disunat Menteri Juliari Batubara..." and ends with "...banteng disebut terlibat."

At the bottom of the frame, a herd of brown, horned bulls moves from left to right. Interspersed among the bulls are several dark grey rats. One rat is emerging from the hole in the white bag. The bulls have curved horns and muscular bodies, shown in various stages of movement. A QR code, barcode, and publication details including "21-27 DESEMBER 2020" and "RP 45.000" are located in the bottom left corner. The top of the cover contains additional text: "FILM PILIHAN TEMPO 2020" and "PELANGGARAN HAM DI ERA JOKOWI".
